faqs.question: Can I bring my own sketch, photo or Pinterest reference?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely! You can share any photo, sketch, or heirloom piece. Our master artisans will translate it into a production CAD sketch and discuss exact dimensions and metal weight.

faqs.question: Can I use my old family gold for making a new custom design?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can melt and purify your old family gold or credit its market purity value towards your new custom ornament, carrying forward your sentimental family heritage.

faqs.question: How long does a custom jewellery design take?
faqs.answer: Typical custom creations take between 7 to 14 days depending on the intricacy of hand-carving and stone setting. Urgent wedding orders can be expedited.

doorstepService.title: Urgent Doorstep Jewellery Repair
doorstepService.description: Can't visit our store? Jewellery broke right before an event? Our mobile craftsman carries specialized portable tools right to your home in Delhi NCR, Chhapra or Siwan for emergency clasp repairs, minor soldering, and ring resizing.

faqs.question: Is it safe to give antique or delicate family jewellery for repair?
faqs.answer: Yes. We photograph and weigh your ornament in your presence before starting work. Every repair is carried out in-house by master goldsmiths under strict supervision.

faqs.question: How quickly can you do urgent doorstep repair?
faqs.answer: For emergency requests in Delhi NCR, Chhapra, and Siwan, our goldsmith can arrive within 2 to 4 hours based on location to fix clasps, broken chains, and urgent earring pins.

faqs.question: What is the cost of repairing a broken gold chain or ring resize?
faqs.answer: Basic solder and clasp fixes start from ₹250 to ₹500. Exact charges depend on whether gold solder or extra metal addition is needed, and we quote transparently upfront.

faqs.question: Can I convert heavy traditional jewellery into modern lightweight wearable pieces?
faqs.answer: Yes! Many clients bring heavy wedding necklaces and we split or remodel them into elegant everyday pendants, lightweight bracelets, or contemporary cocktail rings.

faqs.question: How do you ensure the purity of the remade gold jewellery?
faqs.answer: We melt the gold in your presence or run an authorized XRF spectrometer test to record the exact karats (22K / 18K) before remodeling, ensuring 100% purity guarantee.

jewellery-making.title: Traditional Jewellery Making
jewellery-making.heroSubtitle: Handcrafted jewellery using traditional techniques with fine detailing and long-lasting quality.
introDescription: Founded by Shri Swamy Nath Sah six decades ago, our workshop upholds the sacred art of traditional Indian goldsmithing. Every bangle, kada, and necklace is hand-forged using classical hammers, dies, and hand filigree work that machine manufacturing can never replicate.
features: Authentic Jadau, Polki, and natural gemstone setting
Built for generational longevity and family heirloom inheritance
jewellery-making.processSubtitle: The sacred metallurgical transformation from raw gold to royal masterpiece

processSteps.title: 1. Purity Assay & Smelting
processSteps.description: Crucible smelting of pure certified 24K and 22K gold bullion.

processSteps.title: 2. Hand Wire Drawing & Forging
processSteps.description: Traditional anvil hammering and manual rolling to create metal sheets.

processSteps.title: 3. Hand Carving & Filigree
processSteps.description: Micro-soldering delicate gold wires and embossing regional motifs.

processSteps.title: 4. Stone Inlay & Jadau Work
processSteps.description: Traditional 24K gold foil (kundan) setting of rubies, emeralds, and polki.

processSteps.title: 5. BIS Hallmarking & Luster Polish
processSteps.description: Final inspection, govt BIS hallmarking stamp, and mirror hand buffing.

faqs.question: Is your handcrafted jewellery certified with BIS Hallmarking?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. Every ornament we forge is stamped with government BIS Hallmarking including 6-digit HUID code, 22K (916) or 18K (750) purity marks.

faqs.question: Can you replicate rare ancestral Bihari designs?
faqs.answer: Yes! Originating from Shitalpur, Ekma (Saran, Bihar), our family has specialized in traditional Bhojpuri, Maithil, and Awadhi jewellery such as Hansuli, Dholna, Tikka, Nath, and traditional Kadas for over six decades.
